claim: forwarded listeners are bound to the loopback interface of the bastion
expected: loopback only; unreachable from another container
evidence: listener address 127.0.0.1; curl rc=7 (7 = failed to connect)

claim: a client cannot listen on a port outside its own range (permitlisten)
evidence: bastion log: forward to 20002 denied 1 time(s), to 20010 13 time(s)

claim: client accounts get no command output and no local forwarding
evidence: rc=1; bastion log: 1 refused local port forward

claim: every client login is confined to its chroot directory
evidence: bastion log: Accepted publickey and Changed root directory

claim: the control server checks only 1-65535; the client's range is enforced by the bastion
evidence: server log: task created, claimed and ended with task_error

claim: the separate channel reports why the tunnel failed
expected: reason given by the bastion in the task result
evidence: server log, error of the failed task: "remote port forwarding failed for listen port 20010"

claim: a new task corrects a cause local to the node
evidence: server log: next task claimed and succeeded; task success=True, listener=True, traffic=True

claim: a local supervisor does not correct a wrong parameter
evidence: autossh.log: 11 starts, exit status 255; reason only in the node's stderr (11); bastion denials for 20010: 13 = 11 (autossh) + P3 + P8

claim: a terminated tunnel is restored through the control channel
evidence: tunnel-recovery.csv (listener and traffic by polling) and server log (claim and result of each task)
